Burn it to survive... or keep it?
He walked toward the village lights.
Each day, he found five logs.
Three for the night. Two to spare.
One was too beautiful to burn... so he made a friend.
The forest was lonely. Now it wasn't.
Then came the storm. No wood... and nothing saved.
He barely made it through the night.
Luck saved him. So he never learned.
Every night, another doll. Every night, a smaller fire.
The sled grew heavy. The village, no closer.
No wood left. Only his friend.
The wood that could have carried him there... was beside him all along.
